events.name: Chicago Architecture Center River Cruise Aboard First Lady
events.pleaseNote: Recommended for ages 12 and up. All patrons require a ticket regardless of age. Tour Tips: - Tour departures frequently sell-out. Reserve your tickets in advance to avoid day-of delays. - Skip lines at the box office by choosing "eTickets" as your delivery method. - Make sure your entire party arrives 20 to 30 minutes early at the dock, located at the southeast corner of the Michigan Avenue Bridge at Wacker Drive. - All seats are general admission. The number on your ticket does not represent a seat number. - All seats are sold for outdoor decks. Don't worry, you won't have to sit inside. - Don't forget your camera to capture the beauty of the architecture!

en-us.line3: R I V E R  C R U I S E

venues.name: Chicago Architecture Center - First Lady

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Individual Tickets: 312-922-8687, CAC Member Reservations: 312-922-8687, Groups of 20 or more, please contact groupsales@architecture.org or call 312-322-1130 to make a reservation.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Please check https://firstlady.com/ for First Lady Cruises Dockside Box Office hours.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: First Lady Cruises Box Office accepts Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call ticket pickup is available at First Lady Cruises dockside box office on Michigan & Wacker Dr. We strongly recommend arriving at the box office 30 minutes prior to the start time of your cruise.

venues.parkingDetail: Discounted Parking Available! LAZ Parking Services Garage at 111 E. Wacker Drive (Illinois Center). Receive a discount for up to 4 hours of parking. If you park longer than 4 hours, discount is no longer valid. IMPORTANT: You must have your parking ticket stamped at our ticket window to receive the discounted rate. Note: LAX Parking Services at 111 E. Wacker is not owned or affiliated with First Lady Cruises. The parking information posted here is merely for the convenience of our guests and is not to be construed as a recommendation or endorsement.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Guests with limited mobility please visit https://firstlady.com/accessibility for more information andhttps://firstlady.com/location for drop-off location and directions. Please present yourself to our staff if you prefer early boarding. Chicago's Leading Lady and Chicago's Classic Lady are wheelchair-accessible and offer a wheelchair-accessible family restroom. Tickets for tours on these vessels can be purchased by selecting the 9am, 10am, 11am, 12pm, 1pm, 2pm, 3pm or 4pm departure times. Please also note that all Chicago Architecture Center downtown walking tours are wheelchair accessible.

generalInfo.generalRule: This 90-minute cruise of the Chicago River is complete with educational commentary provided by trained Chicago Architecture Center certified docent guides aboard First Lady Cruises fleet. The tour covers the following routes on the Chicago River: 1. Michigan Ave. & E. Wacker Dr. (starting point) 2. Main branch of river (Canal St. to Navy Pier) 3. South branch of river (to Roosevelt Rd.) 4. North branch of river (to Chicago Ave.) Guests may move freely around the boat and have access to all angles while one of our highly trained docents points out & discusses architectural highlights along the way. The tour will pause three times giving you the prime opportunity to capture the city's architecture. GENERAL ADMISSION SEATING - OUTDOOR SEATING IS GUARANTEED CLIMATE CONTROLLED INTERIOR SALON with air conditioning available on a first come, first served basis. CRUISE TAKES PLACE RAIN OR SHINE THERE ARE NO REFUNDS OR TIME EXCHANGES (Tickets are date and time specific) EVERYONE MUST HAVE A TICKET (Infants and children included)
generalInfo.childRule: Infant priced tickets are available. For infant tickets please call 312-922-8687. Strollers must be folded and stored in the dining salon. Due to Coast Guard regulations everyone who boards the boat MUST have a ticket, even infants and children. Please note: This is an adult oriented event. There are no reduced rates for seniors or children over 3 years old.

ada.adaCustomCopy: Guests with limited mobility please visit www.cruisechicago.com/accessibility for drop-off location and directions. Please present yourself to our staff if you prefer early boarding. Chicago's Leading Lady and Chicago's Classic Lady are wheelchair-accessible and offer a wheelchair-accessible family restroom. Tickets for tours on these vessels can be purchased by selecting the 9am, 10am, 11am, 12pm, 1pm, 2pm, 3pm or 4pm departure times. Please also note that all Chicago Architecture Foundation downtown walking tours are wheelchair accessible.
ada.adaHours: Please visit www.architecture.org for the most up to date hours.

events.name: Balloon Museum | EmotionAir - Art You Can Feel - Chicago
events.description:
Balloon Museum brings EmotionAir to Chicago for the very first time, transforming The Fields Studios into a space where art, inflatables, and emotions collide. This interactive exhibition invites all ages to explore air as both a physical and symbolic medium, featuring large-scale installations, light displays, and hands-on artworks for an unforgettable experience.

For more information, please see our FAQ.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: The Administrative offices of the Broadway Playhouse at Water Tower Place may be reached at (312) 977-1700. There is no public phone number available for the Box Office. The box office cannot take phone orders. To order tickets by phone, please call 800-775-2000. For groups of 20 or more, call (312) 977-1710.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box office hours vary. Please call (312) 977-1700 for the current week's hours.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts cash, Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover. No personal checks, please.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pick up beginning one hour prior to showtime on the day of the event. Customer must present the credit card used to place the order, a valid picture ID, and the confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available at Water Tower Place Parking Garage, located in the lover level of Water Tower Place. Enter just west on the theatre entrance on Chestnut St.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: For wheelchair accessible seating please call Broadway in Chicago at 312-977-1700 ext. 1259

generalInfo.generalRule: There are no refunds or exchanges on tickets purchased for Broadway In Chicago events. Cameras and recording devices are not allowed. Doors open 30 minutes prior to showtime. No outside food or beverages allowed.
generalInfo.childRule: For most productions children under 5 are not permitted for the courtesy of the other patrons. Everyone is required to have a ticket.
